target.statement: Exact conditional moments (mean, variance, third cumulant) of the chi-square-family statistic for a 3x3 table with N=18 (406 tables on the margin fibre) agree with brute-force enumeration to max relative error 8.9e-15, computed in ~5.5 ms.
target.dataset: Simulated 3x3 contingency table, N=18, margins fixed (no external data)

compute.basis: The target is a 3x3 table with 406 tables on the fibre; the paper reports 5.5 ms runtime and the deposited package plus brute-force enumeration check are tiny, so install + run is minutes on a laptop CPU.

title: Exact Conditional Distributions of Chi-Square-Family Statistics for Two-Way Contingency Tables, by Cell-Separable Dynamic Programming
